text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARDENED"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : HARDENED HARDNESS & DEPTH : UPTO 32-35 HRC.THROUGH FINISH & DEPTH : IZBP TEST COUPON SIZE : ⌀40 (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"The drawing specifies hardness (32-35 HRC) but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining and plating). This matters because hardening after machining can distort tight features, while hardening before may require grinding; the designer should add a note specifying the heat-treatment stage.","recommended_correction":"Add a note clarifying when the hardening is performed relative to machining and the IZBP surface treatment."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"-0.007"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"-0.020"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D10","page":1,"quote":"-0.007"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"-0.020"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimensions D8 through D11 define tolerance bands of 0.013 mm on shaft features, and the part is plated (IZBP per title block), yet no allowance is made for plating thickness on these tight fits. Plating buildup will push the finished shaft outside its specified tolerance, potentially preventing assembly with mating parts; the designer should either increase the pre-plate size limits or add a note accounting for coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plating dimensions or add a note specifying that the tolerances apply after IZBP plating, allowing for the coating thickness."}]}
